== Description ==
Original Japanese [[Evader (Japanese)|Evader]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]], black-border printing. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.

== Source and credit ==
Photograph of the physical card from the SWCCG Cards shop listing ''Evader (Japanese)'', <code>https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-anh-bb-ds-evader/</code> (now returns Page not found). Preserved copy of the listing: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260416084518/https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-anh-bb-ds-evader/ Internet Archive] (16 April 2026; page title and image link checked).
